text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the cafeteria struggling to choose
what to
eat when I run into Nakayama
Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Not sure what to pick either?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yooo! The confused-looking duo over there!
Can't make up your minds? Why
not try Golshi's
special fleeting dish
then?! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? What makes it fleeting?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's so rare that it's only served once a
day, if at all! Such a chance-dependent
experience is right up your alley, eh,
Nakayama? Tell me you wanna hear
more!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The dish was prepared by a
cherry-picked
selection of connoisseur
culinarians. The first of
which is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Doto?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The same Doto that's known as the
biggest lover
of spicy food at the
academy?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I can see it now. Bet you just
looking at it
will make your eyes burn.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And the sides were prepared by the one
and only
Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume whose curiosity is
stronger than her common sense. Hehe...
I wonder what she
went and mixed
together.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: On dessert duty was Agnes Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No way. Agnes Tachyon made the dessert? She probably hid something in there and disguised it with pounds of sugar.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And finally, Oguri Cap as the team's
grand
supervisor!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. So, the meal isn't just insane,
it's enough
to last you through the week
as well.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Oh man, I've gotta take you on!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Oh man, I've gotta take you on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quickly warn her that no one else will
help her if
she doesn't finish all her food.
choice_data_list: Calm down! That's definitely not a...
If we take the challenge, we're fi...
If we take the challenge, we have ...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. Fine. I wouldn't want any of it to
go to
waste. I'll order something from
the regular menu.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Grrr. Next time, I'll have to drop in when
your trainer's
not around...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! One fleeting lunch for you!

Oguri-sized!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...
Will I finish it all? Will I end up in
agony? Will my stomach explode?
Oh man, I can't
wait to find out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nakayama Festa eats the
Oguri-sized gigantic lunch and finishes it
all. Apparently, it
doesn't taste too bad
either.
